description: Check a dependency manifest (package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml or Pipfile) for third-party API SDKs that are major versions behind, deprecated or replaced, against the live npm registry and PyPI. Returns each SDK's current spec, latest version, release-notes link and a Versyka migration guide when one exists.

all.description: Check every package, not just third-party API SDKs.

file_name.description: The file name, e.g. requirements.txt. Helps detect the format.

manifest.description: The full text of the manifest file.

name: check_dependencies
title: Check API SDK versions
